snippet.title: Ylem's Cat - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ylem’s Cat is an action-adventure game driven by the bond between a girl and her cat. Led by curiosity and knowledge, Molly sets out on a journey to find her missing mother across a dying planet, exploring ruins and uncovering the truth buried within the giants. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5123770/Ylems_Cat/

Developer: Diamond Cat Studio
